args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required. The unhealthy v2.3.1 remains the known-bad release for follow-up investigation.
